title: GenerationVariant
description: A second take on a generation, asked for as its own piece of work. It says which generation it came from and which job was run for it — the text it produced belongs to that job's own record, not to this edge.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

parentGeneration.description: The generation this is a variant of, by its id in the system that holds it.

job.description: The processing job run to produce it, by its id in the system that runs it. The variant is the link between the two; neither side carries the other.

createdAt.description: When the variant was asked for, which is not when the job finished.
